summary: Frontend-only test of the new layout and navigation (4 areas + central '+' button, AreaTabs, Ufficio and Nuovo sheets, small logo, desktop sidebar grouped by area), at 390px and 1400px, with ephemeral Firebase users. 123 of 124 checks passed in the main script. The follow-up script confirmed numeric badges with real data. The one failure is a small horizontal overflow on /profilo. It only happens with long emails and is not a regression from this layout change.

ui_bugs.issue: The '<Mail/> {user.email}' row has no truncate or break-all. With a long email (the test ones are ~50 characters) the page scrolls sideways by 3-15px at 390px. The text node runs past the card, so document scrollWidth is 404 against a 390 viewport. With a short real email it does not show up. This code was there before the layout change.

verified: mobile-bottom-nav order: bar-agenda, bar-lavori, mobile-new-button (centre, raised), bar-soldi, bar-ufficio
bar-lavori goes to /prossimi-lavori, bar-soldi to /incassi, bar-agenda to /agenda
bar-ufficio opens ufficio-sheet. All 7 tiles (clienti, rilievi, documenti, contratti, magazzino, ore-lavoro, profilo) go to the right page and close the sheet. ufficio-sheet-close works.
Active area is highlighted correctly: lavori on /prossimi-lavori, /in-attesa and /preventivi/:id; soldi on /margine, with lavori not active there; ufficio on every Ufficio page; agenda on /agenda

area-tabs-lavori, area-tabs-soldi and area-tabs-ufficio show up. Every chip goes to its own page and the active chip turns blue. Badges show real counts: Prossimi 2, In attesa 1, Preventivi 1, bar-lavori-badge 2. Contratti badge works on bar-ufficio, menu-nav-contratti and the sidebar.
new-sheet: new-lavoro opens client-form-dialog on /prossimi-lavori, also when you are already on that page. Reloading does not reopen it.
new-preventivo creates a quote and opens /preventivi/:id
new-rilievo opens rilievo-dialog, also when you are already on /rilievi
new-sheet closes with the X button and with a click on the overlay
mobile-logo is 28px tall. app-logo in the desktop sidebar is 36px. On desktop the bottom nav and the mobile logo are hidden.
Desktop sidebar has the groups LAVORI / SOLDI / UFFICIO with all 16 items and badges. side-new-button opens new-sheet, and new-contratto from there works.
contratti-scadenza-banner shows on /prossimi-lavori ('1 manutenzione in scadenza...')

No horizontal overflow at 390px on prossimi, in-attesa, da-preventivare, da-fatturare, spese, fornitori, agenda, clienti, rilievi, documenti, contratti, magazzino, ore-lavoro or the quote editor. The chip row scrolls inside itself (scrollWidth 519 vs 390).
action_items: Optional: add 'min-w-0 break-all' (or truncate) to the email row in the Profilo Account card
critical_code_review_comments: AppShell: badges are only counted for keys pending/awaiting/to_quote/to_invoice/unpaid/contratti. The bar-lavori badge shows only 'pending', not awaiting, to_quote or to_invoice. That looks deliberate, but check it is what you want.
areaOf() uses exact path matching for items, so a page not listed in AREAS (e.g. /archivio/... is in extra, fine) gets no highlighted area. New routes must be added to navConfig.
The contratti badge loader re-fetches on every window focus with no throttling. Not a big problem.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral Firebase users only. The scripts created TEST_ clients, one contract and one quote, deleted them by id through the API, then deleted the Firebase users. Leftover quotes: 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python3 /app/tests/iter44_layout_nav_ui.py (full layout and navigation) and python3 /app/tests/iter44_badges_overflow.py (badges with pending/to_quote/awaiting clients, created with pending:true and then a PUT to set to_quote or awaiting_materials). After login, wait for mobile-bottom-nav: the old mobile-menu-button no longer exists. A contract with data_inizio 6 months ago and frequenza_mesi 6 makes the in-scadenza banner appear.
